pathogenesis: cancer cells can get out of the breast tumor early on, even before the tumor can be detected on mammogram or by breast exam. they do this by moving through the blood and lymph systems.
treatments: systemic therapies—chemotherapy, hormone therapy, or targeted therapy
prognosis: if your recurrence is 10 years after your diagnosis, it's likely that the cells that landed somewhere else in your body were dormant (sleeping) all this time. then something changed and the cells woke up from their hibernation. what changed? did the local environment around the cells change? did your body change in some way that stimulated the cells?
